blocks.text: The two canonical Connection blocks were re-audited as one 18-root subsystem. Supporting review records were cleaned up; the canonical titles, invariant definitions, generated forms, approval migrations, and authority counts did not change.

Verified architecture: CON:0xx names source endpoints, target endpoints, and shared channels as communicative loci. CON:1xx names completed, active, or nonactualized source expression, target reception, and shared distribution through those loci.

Verified non-entailments: an active locus does not imply active traffic; source-expression completion does not imply target reception; target reception does not imply attention or understanding; and shared distribution does not imply uptake by every endpoint. Dormant loci, nonactualized processes, and runtime [2]/num remain distinct.

Cleanup completed: collision rows now follow the second address trit; the original Phase 2 rationale is represented accurately; all 54 runtime explanations are concept-specific; and both packet builders are safe to rerun after approval. The two packet validators, the 15-check combined soundness audit, and the complete 29-check authority regression pass, including all 2,592 generated-form assertions.

Current authority remains 126 canonical roots and 198 provisional roots in 22 nine-root chunks. CON:200–222 remains the next unbegun block. Gate 4, compounds, and translator implementation remain unbegun.
